items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: I played with Willie Paggio. We played up on, at Burgundy and Canelo... I played up there with Willie Paggio for about a year.

ctx.x: It's hard for you. Now, if you have your list there, any other jobs then after those that you mentioned, Bob Lyons and the, is it Darmul Dupass or somebody that you played for at? Right. Right. And who some of your later bands were in the recent years?

Well, I played with Willie Paggio. We played up on, at Burgundy and Canelo, there was a jet and dance upstairs. And I played up there with Willie Paggio for about a year. But before that we played as the Charles and Padres for about six months. Was that another? Another Jitney dance.
Jitney dance. And Willie Meenbart was playing piano. Oh yes.
